points.statement: The framework is designed to auto-organize groups of agents based on large language models to complete navigation tasks.
points.quote: To address this issue, we design the HAS framework to auto-organize groups of LLM-based agents to complete navigation tasks.

points.statement: The structure uses centralized planning with decentralized execution to enable efficient multi-modal navigation in open-ended environments.
points.quote: It utilizes centralized planning with decentralized execution, enabling efficient multi-modal navigation in open-ended environments.

points.statement: Given a navigation goal as images, objects, or audio, groups of agents self-organize to undertake collaborative navigation such as searching and exploring.
points.quote: Given a navigation goal in the form of images, objects, or audio, collectives of agents autonomously self-organize to undertake collaborative endeavors of navigation like searching and exploring.

points.statement: Integrating multi-modal language models into embodied agents enhances navigational efficiency.
points.quote: Integrating Multi-modal Language Models (MLMs) into embodied agents enhances navigational efficiency.

points.statement: By harnessing zero-shot learning and nuanced decision-making abilities of large language models, agents can navigate spaces with efficiency and adaptability akin to human intuition.
points.quote: By harnessing the zero-shot learning capabilities and the nuanced decision-making abilities of LLMs, our agents can navigate these spaces with efficiency and adaptability akin to human intuition.
